title: TIA Portal Call Tree
description: Render a visual tree of block call hierarchy from a JSON call graph
description_cn: 从 JSON 调用关系图渲染可视化的块调用层级树

inputFile.title: Input File
inputFile.description: Path to the JSON call graph file generated by tia-scan-calls
inputFile.description_cn: 由 tia-scan-calls 生成的 JSON 调用关系图文件路径

entry.title: Entry Blocks
entry.description: One or more block names to start the tree from. If empty, shows top-level (uncalled) blocks.
entry.description_cn: 一个或多个入口块名称，从这些块开始展开树。留空则显示顶层（未被调用的）块。

outputFile.title: Output File
outputFile.description: File path to write the tree output. Leave empty to print to console.
outputFile.description_cn: 将树输出写入的文件路径。留空则打印到控制台。

type.title: Block Types
type.description: Filter blocks by type (OB, FB, FC, DB, UDT). Leave empty to include all.
type.description_cn: 按块类型过滤（OB、FB、FC、DB、UDT）。留空则包含全部。

level.title: Max Depth
level.description: Maximum tree expansion depth. 0 = unlimited recursive expansion.
level.description_cn: 树的最大展开深度。0 = 无限制递归展开。
